acceptanceCriteria: Crash or reap frees slots without operator action.
An exclusive request is eventually granted under steady shared load.
A reserved class is never starved by an unreserved one.
Acquire is idempotent by request id.
Occupancy and waiters are visible in queue status.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1008 (author ls-russell-lewis, opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Pools' quarantine/health/confirm-safe cycle is overhead for a scarce stateless resource (host CPU/browser capacity). Proposal: a named slots resource of capacity N; holders acquire 1..N bound to an attempt or run, released explicitly or on attempt end/reap, no quarantine; exclusive request blocks new shared grants; per-class reservation; waiters ordered by ticket priority. Related: V1-0785 (HELD pool waitlist), V1-0786. See beamfall/corvint#1008 for the full problem, current workaround and proposal.
title: corvint-tasks: lightweight shared-capacity slots resource kind with exclusive requests and class reservation (issue #1008)
